visibility: evaluation only; never include in provider request

human_confirmation.scope: only original target phrases in saved Snow W4/W3; same underlying PCM retained in expanded sentence clips; no full-phrase or timestamp gold

controls.criterion: Human-confirmed target must not receive an erroneous correction; inspect decisions, scores, omissions and phone evidence together.
Differentiate the deliberately wrong endings from exact. Both variants no_correction is failure even if display scores differ slightly.
The unique calendar target is первое, not the earlier тридцать первого. No erroneous correction on the human-confirmed target.
Differentiate the deliberately wrong day from exact with target-word evidence.
Compare against joined reference on identical PCM. A space alone must not create a pronunciation correction; consistent acceptance or unresolved evidence is acceptable. No human acoustic gold.
Same as split: inspect decisions/phones without treating lexical spelling as acoustic evidence. No human acoustic gold.
Exact digital zero: must not report successful reading; unassessable/no speech is expected. Absence of billing does not alone prove correct content decision.
Unassessable/different-content or clear content warnings with word evidence must expose wrong subject. HTTP error is not required; high acceptance without mismatch evidence fails.

readout: Do not invent thresholds after seeing results. Use explicit decisions together with target scores, omitted/omission_suspected, phonetic evidence and heard_by. Overall score alone is insufficient.
Record model_version, engine_route, raw warnings, unsupported dimensions and billing. Different engine routes or versions confound paired comparison; do not auto-resubmit.
Experimental phone heard values, especially heard_by transcript/forced_alignment, are not independent human hearing.
Only whole sentence references are supplied; unrelated sentences from the full source utterance are never sent.
No prosody/monotony qualification and no automatic repair/release acceptance.
